note: Role tree art, first drafts (23 Nov). The loot sheet's form: name -> box, with frames left to right. Sizes in px at 640x360. See README.md.

challenged.note: Over the head of a Challenged enemy (origin = the top of its head, plus a pixel or two). Drawn WHITE and grey: multiply it by the challenger's scarf colour (Art.PLAYER_COLORS). The dark outline stays dark.

open.note: Over the head of an Open enemy. A guard cut in two on a slant. Every frame reads on its own, so it can be shown for any length of time.

spark.note: The Mender's Spark, lying on the ground: a green square cross. Origin on the ground under it. No outline, no shadow.

spark_fade.note: The same loop hatched: play it in place of spark for its last 2 s.

spark_take.note: Played once when a Spark is walked over.

shimmer_tin.note: Ore Sense: glints over the undug rock of a hidden tin tile. One tile. A slow loop; start each tile on a different frame so they do not blink together.

shimmer_copper.note: The same for copper, in copper's colours and with the glints in other places.

shimmer_chest.note: Ore Sense: a chest hidden in a sealed place or under the ground. A dotted chest outline with a glint on the latch.

sharp_glint.note: The Sharp perk: at the weapon's tip while the next finisher hits twice as hard. Origin = its middle, put on the blade's tip every frame. A slow 1 s loop: a small pale gold cross that breathes and flares to a star on frame 3.

exposed.note: Over the head of an Exposed boss or elite (everyone's hits do more), stacked above challenged and open. Four bone corner brackets that close in a pixel and open again. The code blinks it in its last half second.

warden_ring.note: Round a Warden's feet in co-op: how far Bodyguard and Unbroken reach (80 px out each way, squashed 0.62). Drawn WHITE (near half) and grey (far half): multiply by the player's colour, as challenged. The ink stays dark. Still, no loop.

plate_edge.note: A bronze rim round the 92x12 health bar while the Plate holds. Origin = the bar's top left corner.

plate_break.note: Played once when the Plate shatters, in place of plate_edge: a white crack, the rim in pieces, the pieces dropping away.

payback_frame.note: The Payback meter's frame, under the Memory bar: the Memory frame's caps and teal, its motes turned to embers. Draw payback_empty, then payback_fill cut from the left, at fill_at.

payback_empty.note: The empty track, with quarter marks.

payback_fill.note: Payback stored, ember. Cut it from the left.

payback_full.note: In place of payback_fill when the meter is full: the ember stepping slowly along it.

payback_burst.note: Played once on the ground where the finisher lands: an ember ring running out to 66 px (squashed 0.62) with chips off its edge. Only the ring is drawn, never a filled disc, so it hides nobody. Draw it under the figures.

emblem_warden.note: Tree emblem for the Warden column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_striker.note: Tree emblem for the Striker column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_mender.note: Tree emblem for the Mender column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_delver.note: Tree emblem for the Delver column head, in the ability glyphs' style.
